label: no_transport
neutral_meaning: The candidate's named transport predicate fails on the scenario.
blocked_inference: Does not imply no target package or no lineage under another criterion.

label: structural_transport_satisfied
neutral_meaning: The named object/invariant satisfies the candidate's typed transport predicate.
blocked_inference: Does not imply target realization, lineage, autonomy, recognition, or ontology.

label: route_dependent_transport
neutral_meaning: Transport verdict or transported structure differs across admissible routes.
blocked_inference: Does not say which route is normatively correct.

label: transport_underdetermined
neutral_meaning: The candidate/instruments do not determine whether the transport predicate holds.
blocked_inference: Must state whether the source is criterion ambiguity, missing data, or scenario underspecification.

label: not_applicable_same_carrier
neutral_meaning: The scenario fails the candidate's distinct-carrier applicability condition.
blocked_inference: Does not deny same-support invariance or usefulness as a control.

label: no_valid_target_package
neutral_meaning: No target episode satisfies the declared target package/gate predicate.
blocked_inference: Does not by itself settle lineage of records or partial structures.

label: target_package_exists
neutral_meaning: At least one target episode satisfies the declared target package/gate predicate.
blocked_inference: Does not imply source-target lineage or autonomy.

label: public_duplicate_with_hidden_mismatch
neutral_meaning: Target matches the declared public/report interface while failing a named hidden, predictive, coherence, or package condition.
blocked_inference: Public mismatch is not required; the hidden mismatch must be named.

label: empty_target_after_viability_failure
neutral_meaning: The target package relation returns empty because a declared viability/maintenance condition fails.
blocked_inference: This is structural extinction under a criterion, not an ontological death claim.

label: target_package_underdetermined
neutral_meaning: Available scenario data do not determine target package satisfaction.
blocked_inference: Must distinguish unavailable evidence from an undefined target predicate.

label: target_package_not_applicable
neutral_meaning: The scenario/candidate has no separately designated target-package question at the declared scope.
blocked_inference: Permitted only with an explicit boundary, such as a same-carrier representation control or genuinely joint distributed object.

label: no_declared_lineage_reaches_target
neutral_meaning: A target package may exist, but the chosen lineage relation has no source-to-target edge.
blocked_inference: Does not imply target nonrealization or metaphysical nonidentity.

label: structural_successor
neutral_meaning: The target is related forward to the source by the declared structural criterion, without a uniqueness/exclusivity claim.
blocked_inference: Does not imply one-to-one continuation or personal identity.

label: one_to_one_lineage_continuation
neutral_meaning: Exactly one target successor is selected within the declared candidate domain and route scope.
blocked_inference: Cardinality one does not license personal identity or global uniqueness outside scope.

label: branch_valued_continuation
neutral_meaning: One source has multiple lineage successors under the declared criterion.
blocked_inference: Does not assert one token is literally numerically identical to all branches.

label: fusion_valued_continuation
neutral_meaning: One target has multiple lineage predecessors under the declared criterion.
blocked_inference: Does not imply identity with every predecessor or preservation of conflicting histories.

label: package_equivalent_duplicate_with_unresolved_token_identity
neutral_meaning: Target tokens are package-equivalent under the declared structure while token/personal identity remains unresolved.
blocked_inference: This is an explicit boundary label, not a hidden assertion that copies are new or same persons.

label: lineage_underdetermined
neutral_meaning: The criterion or available facts do not select a lineage classification.
blocked_inference: Must identify symmetry, missing history, route dependence, or another specific source.

label: lineage_not_applicable
neutral_meaning: The candidate does not define lineage for this scenario class.
blocked_inference: Permitted only with an explicit scope limitation, not silent omission.

label: bridge_dependent_shadow
neutral_meaning: Named target package behavior fails or is undefined when continuing source/bridge/decoder support is withdrawn.
blocked_inference: Does not entail that the coupled distributed assembly lacks a package.

label: autonomous_target_realization
neutral_meaning: A target package exists and remains maintained under the declared withdrawal intervention, environment, disturbance class, and horizon.
blocked_inference: Does not imply lineage or consciousness.

label: autonomy_failure_after_withdrawal
neutral_meaning: A target package exists before withdrawal but fails the declared maintenance condition afterward.
blocked_inference: Does not determine whether a shorter horizon would pass.

label: autonomy_underdetermined
neutral_meaning: The setup or candidate does not determine post-withdrawal maintenance.
blocked_inference: Must state missing intervention, horizon, dynamics, or observability.

label: autonomy_not_tested
neutral_meaning: No autonomy intervention is applicable or supplied for the claim being evaluated.
blocked_inference: Cannot be paraphrased as autonomous.

label: determinate_under_declared_instruments
neutral_meaning: The declared instruments suffice to decide the candidate's structural verdict within stated error bounds.
blocked_inference: Does not make the structural predicate true by observation alone.

label: indeterminate_under_declared_instruments
neutral_meaning: Distinct structural/lineage possibilities remain observationally equivalent under the declared instruments.
blocked_inference: Does not imply metaphysical indeterminacy.

label: instrument_not_supplied
neutral_meaning: The candidate has not supplied a recognition/measurement bridge for this scenario.
blocked_inference: Structural analysis may still be possible in a toy with complete-state access.
